name: Other Religions
overview: Scripture reveals a clear distinction between the worship of the one true God and the allure of other gods unknown to our fathers, warning believers against turning to such false religions even if enticed by close relations (Deuteronomy 13:6). God promises to remove the nations practicing these false religions as His people inherit their lands (Deuteronomy 12:29), while ultimately establishing His kingdom as the supreme and exalted place of worship in the last days (Micah 4:1). The gospel proclaims that salvation comes exclusively through faith in Jesus Christ, whom God gave out of love to save the world rather than condemn it (John 3:16; John 12:47). Believers are commanded to love one another as Christ loved them, reflecting the truth of God’s kingdom amid a world influenced by other religions (John 13:34).
